en: Don't worry, I'm on the case.
If they're smart, they'll stay out of my way.
They don't know who they're dealing with.
Try and stop me. See what happens.
I can take whatever they throw at me.
No one's taking this book from me.
One day, I'm gonna die. But it ain't gonna be today.
It's gonna be a long day, isn't it?
You got my number. Call me anytime.
Time to find me a bar.
I gotta get this book someplace safe.
Might as well enjoy the break while it lasts.
They'll be coming for this book sooner or later.
Ehh, I've gotten shot at enough this week.
I got a case to work.
Not personally, obviously... we, uh, we don't exactly run in the same circles.
We win today, and you will.
With the two of us working together, we only lose if the sun implodes.
It's not Ixia, but it's tolerable.
I'm here because my father asked me to be, not because I want to... But, only a fool doesn't make the most out of every opportunity.
I'm grateful not to be paired up with a human.
No, they're not. But they're not us either. Never forget that.
I'm not sure I need life advice from someone who's only seen the world from an ivory tower.
If we were in Ixia, you wouldn't dare talk to me like that.
Itani lo kisil. Vu sok vogali. (Ixian)
Hey, Bebop. Just... do me a favor: If I'm punching someone in the face, please don't knock 'em away!
Do my best, mate, but I make no promises.
Now, I'm not trying to cast aspersions, Detective, but in my experience organics don't tend to last long in a fight.
Pal, the only thing you gotta worry about is keeping up.
I punch things. How about you?
Oh, this is gonna be fun.
Why, cause I got a jacket?
I got my eye on you.
You ready to tear shit up?
I dunno, you ready to keep up?
Oh, I like your style, big man! This should be fun.
You know how to read that book you're carryin'?
Ohh, well, look at "Mr. 5 Dollar Word" over here!
So am I a moron who can't read or a snob?
I'm not gonna feel sorry when you get shot.

Detective, I'm very good at my job and I assume that between the two of us we should have little trouble dispatching our enemies. But, if things go wrong, then yes, I am absolutely going to leave you to die.
Heard you were in the Baxter Society.
That's not the story going around.
I see we're not letting the truth get in the way of a good story, are we, Detective?
Honest men are hard to come by. They tend to stick out even if they weren't a blue wall of muscle.
He should've never taken out a marker.
I know, I know. I tried to tell him, but you know Lenny, he's always going to Lenny.
It's kind of you to help him.
You goin' to the game on Friday?
Not really making plans this week. Figured I'd see if I survived today first.
I thought unicorns were supposed to be positive?
We're also supposed to be found in the woods, but I wouldn't go camping if you paid me.
I should have never told you about that.
I risk my life 4 times a night on the weekends. I'm pretty good.
Good luck unburdening yourself from the Tome, Detective.
Thanks... wait. What do you know about the Tome?
The ritual is about to begin, perhaps we can discuss this later.
I wouldn’t dream of getting in front of you.
This could get a little rough. If you need help, let me know.
I appreciate your concerns for my safety, but they are unneeded. I’ll be fine.
You afraid of things getting messy, Detective?
You gonna be a team player?
You're just gonna have to wait and find out now, ain't ya?
Mr. Abrams, if you think this is the first fight I've been in, you've never played pinochle in Bristol.
Stay close to me, Professor. I'll keep you safe.
Detective, I was about to say the same thing to you.
I... don't suppose I could... take a look at that tome, when all this is over?
Professor, if things go our way, there won't be a tome for you to look at!
I heard a rumor that you moved in with Lady Geist.
Who would have thought that a simple business card could start a star-crossed romance!
No apologies needed, it wasn't my party. Did you ever meet up with Lady Geist?
It's probably for the best. I heard that woman's bad news.
It sucks the life out of people.
"Nervous" is what I get before finals, this is something a little different.
You gonna say you don't need me to protect you?
You kidding me? These guys are trying to kill us, I'm gonna take all the protection I can get.
You got more sense than I expected.
I'll try not to be offended.
You know they're gonna have guns, right?
Yep. They're also going to have arrows through their necks.
You remind me of my stepdaughter.
No shit?! Tell you what: we survive this, I'll take the whole family out for a drink.
Talon, I know you don't care if you die, but I am highly motivated to stay alive! So please, don't do anything stupid!
Don't worry, Abrams. I'm not dying until I have my revenge.
Stay focused on the task at hand.
You should consider working for the OSIC.
I think you guys have enough people who can kick down doors.
We do. We don't have enough guys who care what doors are getting kicked down.
You're not gonna leave me out to dry, are you?
You may not see me, Detective. But I promise you, I'm doing my part.
You're the sheriff from Macomb, right?
Eh, I don't know... I was thinking you grab them and then I punch their skull in!
Holliday... I don't suppose you're related to...
I try not to think about it.
Hey Fern, next time you're pouring me the good stuff, remember all the times I saved your life today.
So when's the last time you went to Ixia?
New York born and raised, baby!
I haven't seen you in a minute, brotha.
Yeah, case I've been working's been... consuming...
So... you're the Savior of Spanish Harlem, huh?
Heh. Not looking to be deified?
I just wanted to make my neighborhood safe.
The city owes you a debt for taking care of Mendoza.
Humility is good, but word of advice: Don't undervalue your worth.
So, a private detective is a job where you help people, but charge them money?
Help is relative. I'm pretty sure a lot of my clients wished I wasn't honest about what I found.
If we work together, victory is assured.
You're... the most confident dead man I've ever met.
My friend, the grave has no time for pessimism.
You, uh... hot in that thing?
You're worried at the last minute that the Patrons are gonna screw us?
Detective, now more than ever we need hope, not skepticism.
Trust me, my friend. Sometimes, it's the only thing that does.
And now I have to work alongside a brute.
It's a malevolent spirit. Nice book.
You look... remarkably calm for a lady that's about to get shot at.
If I thought we were dealing with anyone competent, maybe I'd be worried.
So you're calm because you're delusional?
Thank you for your help, Detective.
We still got a long way to go before we summon the Patron!
Abrams, if there's one thing I am confident in, it's getting what I want.
Remember: When we summon the Patron, we need to be very specific about what we ask for.
No going into business for yourself!
Alright, Blue Boy, ahhh, let's get to work.
After we win, I'm gonna punch you in the face! Think you'll remember that?!
Bluey, when this is over, if you want The Lash to send you to night-night land, you're welcome to try.
I'm excited for you, Abrams! You get to bathe in the glory of Lash.
Just remember to say "thank you" when this is all over.
Ahhh, so... what does it feel like?
Bein' next to greatness. What does it feel like?
No need to be nervous. I am approachable.
Just wanna get this out of the way: I'm gonna be doing my best to support you, but shit happens and if you end up on the wrong side of a spectral wall... I'm sorry.
Ha, I picked up on that.
How do you not throw out your back carrying all that stuff?
It's lighter than it looks. Souls don't weigh a whole lot.
Just to give you a heads up, I plan on picking... a lot of fights today.
I don't think we've met. I'm Abrams.
Of course we haven't met, I try not to talk to poor people.
Abrams, do whatever I tell you, and we'll get along just fine.
Not your boss, just your better.
So... you one of those vampires who looks young, but is actually 200 years old? Or one of those vampires who's new to the party?
No, I don't work for the department.
Ah. So you value profit over civic duty.
[Scoffs] If you saw my apartment, you'd realize how bad I am at valuing profit.
Maybe you should find a new line of work.
Abrams. That Tome is radiating malice.
Because I'm the only one I can trust with it.
How long have you been working for Nashala?
One doesn't send out a CV to work for the Djinn, they... approach you, with an offer.
You ever regret taking the gig?
Some days are safer than others, but... on the whole, no. I am grateful to be of service.
So, do we wanna have a plan, or we just walk in there punching the hell out of everyone?
I was thinking the latter but, if you wanna mastermind something, we're all ears!
Abrams, I know this isn't exactly the most ideal time to bring it up but, do you remember last week's card game?
We're about to summon the Patron, and you're worried about 50 bucks?!
Makes a lot more sense now. I'll square up after the fight.
Didn't expect to be working with you two today.
A delight for us as well! Our enemies will likely be... less enthused.
Oh, they are going to hate us.
Cool tome! Can I get a look at it?
You're gonna find out real soon, kid.
My parents have a rare bookstore in Soho, they might be able to help you.
One of the first places I tried. Thanks though.
You gonna have Elizabeth Bennett give them a strongly worded letter?
You know, when people insult me they usually go for Mr. Darcy.
Oh my God, I love that you know his first name. Are you an Austen fan? Can we talk about Emma?
Slow down, kid. The ritual's about to start.
I don't like the way you've been looking at the Tome.
I'm warning you, Paradox. You touch my property, you won't like what happens next.
We've been following your work, Detective.
We like secrets and... you seem to have a knack for finding them. But a word of advice: some things aren't meant to be revealed. Stop asking questions about us.
Ugh, I'll keep that in mind.
Just wondering if we're going to have a problem.
With the ritual upon us, Paradox has bigger concerns than your nose in our business. So no, you have nothing to fear from me.
Yeah, but you're not the person who can help me.
Please don't talk to me like you know me.
I knew I didn't like you.
No, when I charge in, make sure ya follow me.
You disobeyin' an order from the king?
I thought I said you weren't supposed to show your face in the sewers again?!
Don't try to skip by on a technicality.
Alright, you big blue crumbum, I'll let it slide... but I got my eye on you.
Let's see if we can get you home.
Oh, that's stupid. Have better dreams.
Oh, we haven't. But I'm fascinated by what you hold.
If you think I'm letting you get your hands on my-
Oh, don't worry, Detective. I know better.
That tome is pulling you into deep waters, Detective. Be careful.
Ehh... don't know if I need life advice from somebody who was caught and executed.
Yet, here I stand. Perhaps you should consider that I know what I'm talking about.
What did you do to end up in Lost Whisper?
I offended small-minded simpletons with fragile egos.
You don't try to obliterate someone's soul just because they offended you.
How long have you been with the Baxter Society?
Didn't think they let guys like you in.
Wasn’t easy. Who knows, in a few more years they might actually start to respect me.
And how long did it take you to do your hair?
Please. I wake up looking this pretty.
I’ll make ‘em bleed, you finish ‘em off.
Good to see you too, Lilah.
After the ritual, wanna make some bad decisions for old time's sake?
I don't know if that's a good idea.
When did you become so boring?
I've always been boring. You just never noticed cause I'm so damn handsome.
Good. Still workin' the book case?
You workin' the case or not?
I'm carrying it, what do you think?
Abe, I can't figure out why you do half the things you do, so I figured I might as well ask.
Well, don't you look all composed.
Figure I can wait a few minutes before I start punchin' people in the face.
What can I say? I'm growing as a person.
You should have handed over the Tome the moment it came into your possession.
Last I checked, this doesn't belong to the Vatican.
No. But I'm the only the one I trust to get rid of it.
I'm talking to you, aren't I?
Didn't expect to see you again.
I can't tell if you're happy or disappointed.
Hate my methods all you want, I saved lives.
There was a way to save more.

No, there was a way to risk more, and God help us all if we failed. I don't blame you for not having the stomach to do what needed to be done, but sleep easy knowing that what happened in that brownstone is my burden alone, not yours.
You're a good man, Detective. If this is my last battle, I'm happy to have it be with you.
Heard you love a good mystery.
Can you help me with mine?
Help me summon the Patron, and I'll see what I can do...
You look like you've seen some shit.
You, uh... wanna talk about it?
Great. Me neither. Just felt like something I was supposed to say.
Don't suppose one of your cases ever had you bumping into some mad genius that lost one of his creations?
You need me to buy you a pair of shoes?
You wanna walk in Times Square barefoot, be my guest!
I'm trusting you to help keep me alive.
Don't worry, Detective. I'll do my part.
How long you been in New York?
That had to be an adjustment.
It was wonderful and horrifying in equal measure.
I didn't mean to offend you. I'm just socially awkward!
That's, uh... that's good to know.
Huh. I punch people with my fists.
"Who is the Adversary and why are they massacring the denizens of the Deep?"
Oh! I, uh... thought you were going to say something like "Murder on the Orient Express".
We're gonna have a blast, Abe, don't sweat it.
Abe, you wanna meet up for a drink after this?
Am I buyin- No! I'm not buy- I'm a lady! Have some manners!
Buddy, you don't gotta tell me.
Because I can't just leave it lying around.
What do you think I'm trying to do?
Guess we're about to find out.
Sometimes, the ends justify the means.
Must be nice being able to delude yourself into thinking that the world is just black and white.
Just sell the damn book already.
Yeah yeah, wrong hands, blah blah- Abe, you're not the chosen one. You're just a guy who was dealt a bad hand. Dump the book and get your life back.
That's what today is all about.
I don't think today's the day for gambling.
Today's the best day for gambling, you really think if this goes sideways we're walkin' outta here alive?
50 bucks on the higher body count?
Let me guess: You're asking the Patrons for money.
No, I'm thinking smart. When it comes to making wishes, you keep that shit as simple as possible to avoid loopholes.
ああ、コイツ話しかけてくる。(Ugh, this guy is talking to me.)
You haven't done me any favors.
I haven't cut you down where you stand.
I see we're setting the bar nice and low.
それしか知らないんだろ。(I bet that's all you know.)
Uhh... トイレはどこですか？(Where is the bathroom?)
One, five, ten. I don't care how many there are! I'll stand up to them all.
I'm not afraid of the mob.
This book is dangerous. I can't let it fall into the wrong hands.
They're not gonna wanna get up close.
If they try to step to me, they're gonna regret it.
Some moron is gonna try to punch me and they're not gonna like what happens next.
No one stands toe-to-toe with me.
You'd think that people would know by now that fighting me is a mistake.
Those idiots wanna walk up to me and die, that's fine by me.
This book is gonna give 'em more than they bargained for.
Let's see what this book can do.
Just need to last a little longer!
This book better save my ass!
No one stands in my way.
If they don't get out of the way, that's on them.
I'm not afraid to charge into a fight.
I don't run from a fight.
It's not smart to get in my way.
The only way to face a problem is head-on.
I'm almost feeling like myself again.
If they wanna kill me, they're gonna have to work for it.
I'll fight to the bitter end.
I didn't survive this long just to die here.
In the end, I will be the one still standing.
I know how to take a hit.
I can jump into the fight!
Ready to throw the book at 'em.
Ready to slam this book down!
I'll make that damned book work for me.
I know how to make an entrance.
Oh, I'll be ready when this thing tries to fly away.
Listen here, book. You work for me.
[Sigh] I'm going to be holding onto a book for dear life. Great.
I gotta figure out how to use this damn book before it gets me killed!
This should keep 'em on their toes.
No one is taking this tome from me!
This thing's gonna get me killed...
You're not ready to fight someone like me.
Looks like it's my day after all.
All the money in the world can't buy talent.
You thought you were gonna keep me down?
Come on! Try to kill me!
Come on! Try to kill me!
You guys getting the message yet?
You aren't worthy to fight me.
Keep throwing your lives away! It's fine by me.
Time to punch the hell out of people!
Ugh, that book's rubbing off on me!
I need to go back and train.
Wonder what I can get at the shop.
I should check out that shop.
Got enough for the best gear!
Might wanna get a new relic.
I should spend the cash when I get the chance.
I can get some serious gear.
I got a whooole lot of souls to spend.
Can't let all these souls go to waste.
Who do you think you were punching?
I shouldn't leave that lying around.
I'm not leaving this lying around.
I'm not saying no to free money!
A little extra scratch never hurts!
Job's done, that's all that matters.
We got what we came for.
Pushed it a little too close.
Gonna go heal. Then, I'll be back in the fight.
An ambush could be coming from anywhere.
I may be tough, but I don't wanna take on the whole team alone!
Looks like I'm the only one left.
I may be tough, but I don't wanna take on the whole team alone!
I can hold on until the others are back up!
Not sure I want to take 'em all on.
Rejuv's in hand! Now's our chance!
Good. Now we get to kill 'em twice.
They got the rejuvenator! We need to be smart.
Need to get back out there.
Need to get back out there.
I can't let my team down.
The time to rest is over.
I need to go win this thing.
Can't let the team have all the fun.
You're on your own for now.
I'll be back when I can.
They were never gonna stop us.
They fought hard. They couldn't match us.
Maybe trusting people isn't so bad after all.
They'll need all the luck they can get.
They should run now and save us all some time.
They're going to be salty about that.
I was worried there for a minute.
Damn, you're accurate with that thing.
Glad we have the old man on our side.
Cutting it a little close, Talon!
Fern made short work of that.
Stick with me, Ivy. We'll be doin' this all day!
Thanks for keeping me in the fight!
They couldn't have seen that coming.
Lash just came out of nowhere!
That wall is just mean, McGinnis!
I knew I could count on you, McGinnis.
They didn't even have a chance.
I dealt with the little tyrant.
I don't care if you're Dauphin, Apollo! Come at my people, and I beat you down.
That thing never had a chance!
No no no no no no!
Y'gotta be faster than that, Bebop!
That laser supposed to be impressive?
You really want to go toe-to-toe with me?
You talked shit to the wrong guy, Billy.
I ain't scared of a goat.
Little different than fighting a middle-aged man in a board room, isn't it, Calico?
You took out the wrong contract, lady.
You want to kill me, Calico? Get in line.
Picked a bad day to leave the sideshow.
There's other ways to help Lenny, Celeste.
Damn it, Celeste! You should've come to me for help.
Celeste, what the hell are you doing here?
Just stay in your fancy hotel!
That guy gives me the creeps...
Guess the rumors about The Baroness are true.
I'm not letting a man like him get the Tome.
Go back to whatever swamp you crawled out of.
It takes more than whistling to spook me.
Glad I walked out of that fight in one piece.
He seemed like a decent guy. Almost feel bad...
If I'm gonna die, it ain't gonna be to someone with patches on their elbows.
Keep an eye on the professor!
Look out for a black hole!
The hell is that kid holding?!
I can't let her get the Tome!
You think you're the first necromancer who tried to take this from me?
Killed the old man! Shit, I killed an old man.
Any other day, I'd be fighting by your side, Grey Talon.
You never should have let me get this close to you, Talon.
What did I do to piss off the feds?
I never wanted the OSIC as an enemy.
You were never escaping me, Haze.
Cute trick, Haze. It wasn't enough.
Picked a bad time to visit New York.
If I wanna solve my case, I gotta end yours.
I'll make it up to you later, Fern.
He won't be starting fires anytime soon.
Hope I didn't kill my bartender for nothing.
You never had what it takes, Infernus.
Couldn't let you pull that off, Fern!
I feel pretty guilty about that... Not guilty enough not to punch her again but, still, guilty.
You picked the wrong side, Ivy.
You never should have come for me, Ivy.
Who wears a parka this time o' year?
You seem like a decent guy, Kelvin. But you had to be stopped.
What are you gonna do, ice skate me to death?
You were never getting away, Kelvin.
I'll stop the Oathkeeper if it's the last thing I do!
I knew I couldn't trust you, Geist.
She's probably gonna want me to move out.
This... is gonna be awkward back at the apartment.
Geist is going to try to steal your health!
Don't get too close to Geist!
We gotta make a move while she's still down!
He had to stop jumping around some time...
He thought ego was a substitute for talent.
That... felt more satisfying than it should.
You're not the one in control here.
Takes more than some machines to stop me.
Should've stayed in the workshop, McGinnis.
How many of these things does McGinnis have?
You're never going to be Viscount, Mina.
You’re not feeding off of me, Mina.
The brave are the first to die.
I'll buy you guys a round at Jezebel's later.
See you at the game Sunday, Krill.
I'll make it up to those guys another time.
Your dad was supposed to tell you to stay away from the Tome!
I can't let you have this book, Paige.
That almost felt worse than the time I had to punch a babysitter.
You seem like a good kid. I'm sorry.
You weren't a threat. Just a nuisance.
You're clever, lady. But not as clever as you think you are.
Gotta try better than that, Paradox.
You really think your little party trick would make a difference?!
You're a good kid, Pocket. This ain't the life for you.
Take your case and get outta town, Pocket!
I know who you are, Pocket. Trust me when I tell you, it's not worth it!
These aren’t the Warrens, and you aren’t my king.
Look at me! Rubbing shoulders with royalty.
Surprised that he showed his face on the surface.
Go find a slumber party, Rem.
What the hell was that kid?
I'm not afraid of you, Seven!
Men like you deserve to rot in Lost Whisper.
He was a tough son of a bitch.
Now the Baxter Society is hunting me.
Takes more than a couple of knives to take me down.
I'm glad Competent Lilah didn't show up today.
If she wasn't nursing a hangover, I woulda been in trouble.
Always knew that lady was bad news...
Bad news, guys: Silver's a functioning alcoholic!
That right there is why I'm not getting married.
I'm too old for magic tricks.
You got a lot of balls showing your face in my city, Father.
I really hoped I would never see that guy again.
There's no reasoning with a man like him.
Who the hell made that guy?
You made me do this, Vindicta!
Your anger is justified. But your methods are not.
There’s other ways to get what you want, Vindicta.
You think you had range on me?!
New York ain't the place for you, Viscous.
I dealt with the pile of goo.
Vyper, just go to Atlantic City already!
Couldn't slide your way outta that one, Vyper.
You're not hawking the Tome, Vyper!
There's a fine line between devotion and obsession, Warden.
I had to stop you, Warden!
You really need a new hobby, Warden.
Don't let Warden get near you!
You really thought some cards were going to stop me?
Hope she's still taking action on the Knickerbockers.
This better not kick me out of Sunday's card game...
I'll put a stop to the Seventh Moon.
Yamato, you were never going to stop me!
You'll get this book over my dead body, Yamato.
I'm sorry about your brother, but this book can't help you.
She won't be easy to kill.
Abrams has the heart of a warrior!
Glad the blue guy's on our side.
There goes a man of conviction.
Come on, big guy, you can do this!
They're not able to stop Abrams!
That is a very scary man!
Abrams has them on the run!
We need to back up Abrams!
We need to capitalize on this!
It's a joy watching you work, Abrams.
The detective will run through them all!
He's a tough bastard, I'll give him that.
I've never seen a man take such punishment.
They don't have an answer for Abrams.
Abrams is a killing machine! But not a literal machine. Because he's made of flesh and bone. But you can't see the bone. It's under his skin.
That man fights like a demon! That's... barely unsurprising, actually.
You just can't stop that guy!
あの悪魔は何かに取り憑かれているのか。
奴らにエイブラムスは倒せん。
あの刑事はなかなかタフだな。
He forgot where he came from.
I hate to do that to a fellow Ixian.
Why aren't you standing with me, brother?!
I take no joy in cutting down one of my own.
He was a titan of a man… a shame he made bad life choices.
You ain't gonna stop me, Abrams!
No one's getting between me and helping Ms. Shelly!
You think you can bully me?!
You think cause you're bigger than me, you're better than me.
Looks like you're not as strong as you think you are, pal.
Where's my team at?! We gotta kill Abrams!
How am I supposed to kill this guy by myself?
Oh. You went melee Abrams. Real original, pal.
Yeah, I bought Healbane. It didn't do dick to stop Abrams!
Abrams, you picked a fight you were never going to win.
That book was always gonna lead ya to your death, Abrams.
You weren't meant to hold that Tome, Abrams!
I'm not gonna be your punching bag, Abrams.
Detective Abrams has been put down.
You're out of your element, detective.
You can't punch your way through every problem, Abrams!
The Tome is an impossible burden, detective. Why don’t you lay your head down and enjoy the amenities that The Baroness can offer?
The Tome will pull you down with it, Abrams. It is inevitable.
He was a big boy, now wasn't he?
It's fun when they're strong like that.
Ho-ho, he put up a good fight!
I like you, detective. You're fun to play with.
Hope you didn't have any friends on the force...
That was a very large man.
Can't believe I took down Abrams.
What does it take to stop this man?!
My mentor says she needs that tome!
You are messing with forces you don't understand, Abrams!
Someone stop this guy from healing!
I wish there was another way.
Any other day and we could've been allies.
You gave me no choice Abrams!
The detective is no longer a threat.
Not even the Tome could save him.
Abrams... I hoped it wouldn't have come to this...
Now we don't need to worry about Abrams for a while.
I hate takin' out my regulars.
How much damage can this guy take?
